Last Thursday, Mia and Amy went to the birthday party. They took many photos at the school hall. Life is full of small surprises. Also, mum looked worried when I came home late.
Mia learned a lot about music. Mia and Amy had great fun there. Mia usually has salad for breakfast. What's more, can you help me carry these heavy boxes?
Mia plays volleyball with Amy every Thursday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the birthday party by bike. Amy's birthday is in February. I study English on Tuesday evening.
Mia hopes to visit London one day. There are always many people at the school hall. Mia thinks music is interesting but a little difficult.
